{{otheruses redirect|Dreamer|NPCs seen during the [[Fighting the Nightmare|sylvari tutorial]]|Dreamer (NPC)}} {{Weapon infobox | uslot = Superior Sigil of Purity | type = short bow | level = 80 | salvage = none | bound = account use | skin = The Dreamer (skin); The Lover (skin); Feathers of Dwayna (skin); The Lover Experiment (skin) | rarity = Legendary | prefix = selectable | id = 30686 | gallery2 = The Dreamer stowed.jpg | gallery2-text = Stowed. }} [[The Dreamer]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] short bow crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]]. == Lore == {{Legendary unlock text|The Dreamer is as mystifying as it is perplexing, for such a creature doesn't exist within the known world. It is quite popular among the [[skritt]], though, who idolize its colorful...prowess.}} == Acquisition == === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Recipe === {{recipe | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 The Lover | ingredient2 = 1 Gift of The Dreamer | ingredient3 = 1 Gift of Fortune | ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Mastery }} == Graphics == [[The Dreamer]] is an [[w:alicorn|alicorn]]-styled bow; it has wings on the top, a unicorn's head in the middle, and a tail at the bottom. It also has flowing pastel pink and blue tassels on the top and bottom. ;Aura * The user arms are covered with pink sparkling aura. Leaving rainbow trail. *When drawn a unicorn motif with two rainbow swirling around it is briefly seen. ; Footfalls * The user leaves behind rainbows and rainbow horseshoes. ;Drawn * Rainbow ribbons swirl around the player as rainbow colored glitter shoots out. A purple glittering unicorn appears and leaps up and away from the player's torso. ; Skill effects * A neighing sound is heard upon firing the bow. * Default projectiles are replaced with a large unicorn running along a purple path. The unicorn's mane starts out being short and red/orange in color, but grows into a rainbow and becomes the trail of the projectile. This effect changes the following skills: ** {{ranger}} [[Ranger]]: [[Crossfire]], [[Poison Volley]], [[Quick Shot]], [[Crippling Shot]], [[Concussion Shot]], and [[Throw Dirt]] (downed skill). *** {{Soulbeast}} [[Soulbeast]]: any projectile from Soulbeast pet skills such as [[Narcotic Spores (soulbeast)|Narcotic Spores]]. ** {{renegade}} [[Renegade]]: [[Shattershot]], [[Bloodbane Path]], [[Sevenshot]], [[Citadel Bombardment]], and [[Essence Sap]] (downed skill). ** {{t}} [[Thief]]: [[Trick Shot]], [[Surprise Shot]], [[Cluster Bomb]], [[Detonate Cluster]], [[Disabling Shot]], [[Choking Gas]], [[Infiltrator's Arrow]], [[Trail of Knives]] (downed skill) and projectiles acquired through [[Steal]]. ** {{en}} [[Engineer]]: [[Arc Detonator]]. Additionally, [[Grenade Barrage]] is replaced with exploding unicorns. === Gallery === The Dreamer aura.jpg|Aura Effect. The Dreamer drawn (animation).gif|Drawn effect. prefixes == * The following [[Attribute combinations|prefixes]] can be selected: {{prefix selection|all legendary}} == Trivia == *The Dreamer, and its prerequisite [[The Lover]], may be a reference to lyrics ''"The lovers, the dreamers, and me"'' from [[w:Rainbow Connection|The Rainbow Connection]]. *The motif of the unicorn and rainbow might be a reference to the flash game ''[[w:Robot Unicorn Attack|Robot Unicorn Attack]]'', which featured a (robot) unicorn able to dash with a rainbow aura. The game over screen also tells the player "your dreams did not come true" and prompts the player to "chase your dreams again" by pressing a button, which might have influenced the name of the short bow. *The [[ArenaNet]] logo on the flank of the unicorn is a reference to the [[w:My Little Pony|My Little Pony]] franchise, in which characters have a symbol (cutie mark), which represents a special talent or prominent personality trait, displayed on their flanks. == See also == * [[The Dreamer I: The Experimental Short Bow]] * [[The Dreamer II: The Perfected Short Bow]] * [[The Dreamer III: The Lover]] {{Legendary weapon nav}} [[Category:Legendary weapons|D]] [[Category:Weapons with unique sounds|D]] [[de:Der Träumer]] [[es:El Soñador]] [[fr:Le Rêveur]]
